days.title: Idyllic Valleys and Ancient Woods of Elm and Lappwald
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Elm
stops.detail: The Elm is considered the largest beech forest in Northern Germany.

stops.name: Lappwald
stops.detail: It is characterized by the forested ridges of Elm, Lappwald, and Dorm, as well as the area of the Helmstedt Hollow.

stops.name: Reitlingstal
stops.detail: The Reitlingstal in the Elm and the Brunnental in the Lappwald are considered particularly idyllic.

days.title: Ridges and Historic Stones of the Northern Park Areas

stops.name: Dorm
stops.detail: The nature park includes the ridges, landscapes, and forest areas of Elm, Lappwald, Dorm, Elz, Helmstedter Mulde, Rieseberg, and Rieseberger Moor, as well as the Kampstüh forest near Lehre.

stops.name: Goldene Hirsch
stops.detail: It is possible that during this time the Golden Stag, the largest stone in the Elm, was also transported to its location near Schöningen.
